dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave trailing edge exhibiting a jagged spline profile due to multiple notches; curvature increases significantly at the lower third of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with an obtuse pixel radius at the highest vertical morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Shallow convex slope approximately 30 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Highly elongated base relative to vertical height, with an approximate ratio of 2.8:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple irregular notches and serrations along the trailing edge; visible light-colored linear scar or depigmentation on the upper lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique notched profile of the trailing edge serves as a primary identifying feature.
